jobs.description:
For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Zottegem.Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit? 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

For our client in the Kortrijk region, we are looking for a motivated Carpet Finishing Operator to strengthen our team on the finishing line.

 

• Cutting and finishing carpets to size

• Processing carpets on the finishing line

• Carrying out quality checks

• Attaching fringes when necessary

• Applying labels to carpets

• Ensuring a neat and high-quality finish

Job Requirements:

• You are precise and enjoy working with your hands

• You have an eye for quality and attention to detail

• You can work independently, but you are also a team player

• Experience in carpets, textiles or garment manufacturing is a plus

• Experience is not required: motivation and a positive work attitude are important

• You speak Dutch, French or English

jobs.occupation: Store Assistant / Sales Associate – Christmas Shop | Bruges | Full-Time
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a welcoming retail environment and love the magic of Christmas? Do you enjoy helping customers find the perfect decorations for the holiday season?

For a unique Christmas store in the heart of Bruges, we are looking for an enthusiastic Store Assistant / Sales Associate who will help customers bring the Christmas spirit into their homes.

What will you do?As a Sales Associate, you will be the face of the store and ensure that every customer enjoys a warm and pleasant shopping experience.

Your responsibilities include:

• Welcoming and assisting customers in a friendly manner
• Advising customers on Christmas decorations, ornaments, gifts and seasonal products
• Maintaining an attractive and organized store presentation
• Restocking shelves and keeping the store clean and tidy
• Processing payments and handling cash register duties
• Assisting with deliveries and unpacking new merchandise

• You enjoy working with customers and providing excellent service
• You are willing to work weekends on a rotating schedule
• Previous retail or sales experience is an advantage
• You speak Spanish, Dutch or English fluently
• In addition to your strongest language, you can communicate at a basic level in at least one of the other languages
• You enjoy working in an international environment with tourists and visitors from different countries
• You are enthusiastic, reliable and enjoy working as part of a team

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

About the RoleAre you a hands-on technical professional who enjoys troubleshooting industrial equipment as much as carrying out practical maintenance and repair work?

For an industrial production site in Louvain-la-Neuve, we are looking for an Electromechanic & Technical Handyman to join the team.

This is a varied role combining 50% industrial electromechanical maintenance and 50% general technical maintenance. You will play an important role in ensuring the reliability of the production line while keeping the company's facilities and infrastructure in good condition.

Your Responsibilities50% – Electromechanical MaintenanceMonitor the production line and identify technical faults or malfunctions.Diagnose electrical and mechanical problems and determine their root causes.Carry out repairs and implement effective technical solutions to minimize production downtime.Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on production equipment.Check the proper functioning of machines and production installations.Inspect electrical wiring and cabling and carry out troubleshooting when necessary.Identify potential technical improvements to increase equipment reliability and performance.Follow all applicable safety, quality and hygiene procedures.50% – Technical Handyman & Facility MaintenanceCarry out general maintenance and repair work throughout the company.Perform painting, minor renovation and finishing work.Repair and maintain gates, doors and other company infrastructure.Handle minor electrical, mechanical and technical repairs within your area of competence.Identify maintenance needs and take the necessary corrective actions.Ensure that buildings, facilities and work areas remain safe, functional and well maintained.Support the team with various practical maintenance tasks as required.

We are looking for a versatile, hands-on professional with a strong technical background and a proactive approach.

You ideally have:

Previous experience in industrial maintenance.Good knowledge of industrial electricity and mechanics.Strong knowledge of electrical wiring and cabling.The ability to diagnose faults, identify their causes and find practical solutions.Knowledge of pneumatics, hydraulics or automation is an advantage.Experience in the food, pharmaceutical or chemical industry is a strong asset.Practical skills in general maintenance, repairs and basic building work.A good understanding of safety procedures and technical instructions.A structured, methodical and independent approach to your work.A strong sense of responsibility, flexibility and problem-solving skills.

 

LanguagesEnglish: Very good proficiency.French: Very good proficiency.You must be comfortable communicating in both languages in a professional working environment.

Working HoursMonday to Friday.Flexible working schedule between 06:00 and 22:00, depending on the company's operational needs.Availability to work within this time window is required.

For our client in Tielt, specialized in recycling foam materiales is looking for an extra co-worker.

Tasks:

- setting up and starting the machine

- quality control

- discharge and supply of raw materials with forklift truck

- keeping work area tidy

- You have experience driving a forklift

- You have no physical complaints

- You speak, understand and read English well

- Working in 2 shifts.

You'll join a close-knit team of approximately 15 colleagues where communication lines are short and everyone knows each other. In the workshop, you'll work closely with Hendrik, the experienced workshop manager, and a fellow technician. Hendrik has years of experience in the trade and enjoys sharing that knowledge with you. He values quality and craftsmanship but is also open to discussion and good collaboration.

No two days are the same. You'll work on a modern fleet of diesel and electric buses, ensuring our customers can travel safely and worry-free.

You'll be responsible for:

• Preparing new vehicles delivered directly from the factory

• Performing maintenance and repair work on both diesel and electric buses

• Diagnosing and resolving electrical and electronic faults using diagnostic equipment and software

• Mechanical repairs including brakes, suspension, drivetrain and other technical components

• Carrying out interventions and emergency repairs when needed

• Accurately recording completed work

• Working on vehicles from TEMSA, Higer, EVM, Tremonia and Mercedes Sprinter conversions

This role is for a technician who enjoys diving into diverse technical tasks.

Here’s what we’re looking for:

• Experience in automotive, trucks, buses, vans, or similar technical environments.

• Solid knowledge of mechanics and electrical systems.

• An affinity for diagnostic techniques and electronic systems.

• A drive to learn and grow in the field of electric vehicles.

• Self-driven, responsible, and solution-oriented work style.

• A valid category B driver’s license.

• Fluency in Dutch or English.

• Availability for on-call duty.

Preferred but not required:

• An HEV certificate (E2/E3) or the willingness to earn it.

• Category D driver’s license is a plus.

jobs.occupation: IT Support Technician – L1 Resident Engineer (M/F/X)
jobs.description:
As L1 Resident Engineer, you are the first point of contact for all IT incidents and requests on site. You combine deskside support and helpdesk. 

User support
  
• Provide Level 1 IT support, on site and remotely, to employees at the Liège site 
• Diagnose and resolve common incidents: laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, printers, headsets and peripherals 
• Support Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365 environments (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive), as well as basic application support 
• Resolve basic connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN) 
• Support meeting rooms and videoconferencing equipment (Teams, cameras, microphones, screens)  
Access and security
  
• Manage access: accounts, password resets, MFA and authentication, in line with security procedures 
• Apply IT security policies and immediately report any suspicious incident (phishing, malware, unauthorised access)  
Hardware and lifecycle
  
• Install, configure and prepare IT equipment (PCs, iOS/Android mobile devices, peripherals) 
• Handle IT onboarding and offboarding of employees (workstation preparation, handover and collection of equipment, access rights) 
• Keep the IT inventory up to date and coordinate replacements, warranties, repairs and disposals 
• Tickets, escalation and coordination 
• Log, prioritise, track and close tickets in the ITSM tool (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management…) 
• Escalate complex incidents to L2/L3 teams with a full diagnosis, and follow them up in line with SLAs 
• Act as the link with central IT teams, service providers and external suppliers 
• Inform local management of major incidents or service interruptions 
• Contribute to IT documentation (knowledge base, procedures, troubleshooting guides)  
You are not just a ticket-taker: you are the local IT point of reference and help ensure the continuity of the site's IT services.
 
THE TEAM & THE MANAGER
 
Based at the Liège office, you report directly to the Station Manager, Pierre Jeurissen. You work closely with SAL International's IT teams in Belgium and Saudi Arabia.

Essential 
 
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical qualification in IT 
• At least 2 years' experience in helpdesk, service desk, desktop support or field support 
• Fluent French and English, both spoken and written 
• Strong command of Windows 10/11 and Microsoft 365; basic knowledge of Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD) and MFA 
• Basic knowledge of networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP) and cybersecurity  
Assets
  
• Knowledge of Arabic 
• Experience as a Resident Engineer / Onsite Support Engineer 
• Experience in the aviation or logistics sector, in an international environment 
• IT certifications (CompTIA A+, ITIL Foundation, Microsoft…)  
Soft skills
  
• Customer focus and service mindset 
• Autonomy and rigour in incident management 
• Clear communication with non-technical users 
• Hands-on, proactive attitude

Company Activities

Our client is a leader in the travel bag, luggage, and accessories industry, known for combining style with cutting-edge design technology and a commitment to quality and durability. With over a century of heritage, they offer unparalleled products that meet the needs of travelers worldwide. Their brands are sold in over 100 countries, providing a diverse and inclusive work environment that values sustainability and innovation.

 

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a Mold Technician? Our client is seeking a skilled and motivated individual to join their team in Oudenaarde. As a Mold Technician, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation and maintenance of molds used in production.

Key Responsibilities:

• Independently assemble, disassemble, and maintain molds to ensure they are production-ready.
• Repair hydraulic cylinders and create flexible hoses for hydraulic and gas applications.
• Conduct fine mechanical work and apply simple sandblast structures.
• Diagnose and propose technical improvements for defective molds.
• Occasionally engage in turning, milling, and grinding tasks with training provided when necessary.

Profile Description

The ideal candidate for the Mold Technician role possesses:

• A Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or an A2 in mechanics with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar position.
• Experience in a production environment, especially in machining operations such as turning, grinding, and milling.
• Strong technical insight and a passion for mechanics.
• Basic knowledge of electricity.
• Resilience under pressure and willingness to work in a two-shift system after the training period.
• Good knowledge of English or Dutch.

Our client is a leading Belgian dealer and service partner for commercial vehicles, vans, and trucks, with multiple locations across East and West Flanders, including Brugge, Ardooie, Bavikhove, Deinze, and Aalter. The company is known for its expertise, customer-focused approach, and commitment to quality service.

Jobomschrijving

We are looking for a Diagnostic Technician to join a growing and stable automotive company specializing in vans and trucks. Brand experience is not important. What matters most is your diagnostic knowledge and ability to identify and solve technical issues efficiently.

As a Diagnostic Technician, you will be responsible for:

• Performing advanced mechanical, electrical and electronic diagnostics on vans and trucks using diagnostic equipment and vehicle software.
• Identifying faults and determining the most efficient repair strategy.
• Repairing and adjusting mechanical, electrical and electronic systems based on diagnostic findings.
• Communicating diagnostic results and completed repairs clearly to workshop management and service advisors.

Candidate Profile

• Passion for automotive technology and troubleshooting.
• Technical education in automotive engineering, mechanics, electricity, or equivalent practical experience.
• Good knowledge of vehicle diagnostics and diagnostic software.
• Experience with diagnostic equipment is required.
• Experience with a specific vehicle brand is not necessary.
• Experience with vans, commercial vehicles or trucks is an advantage.
• HEV1 certificate is a plus.
• Analytical, accurate and problem-solving mindset.
• Candidates must be able to communicate in Dutch or English.

About the company:

Our client, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company introducing innovative CAR-T cell therapy. Their team is making a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a strong growth phase and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for individuals interested in joining their team as a Support Operator/Laboratory Disinfection Specialist.

Before you join their professional team, you will receive thorough training in aseptic (germ-free) work, GMP, and related procedures. As a support operator, you will be responsible for maintaining the assigned areas and production zones in the laboratory in spotless condition. With the utmost precision, you will ensure the maintenance of equipment used, and the cleanliness and disinfection of materials. You will handle cleaning agents and materials safely and correctly. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly controlled environment where your attention to detail can impact human lives.

 

Step into the world of biotechnology and become part of a dynamic team!

Profile:

• Cleanliness and order are very important to you.

• Experience in a sterile environment is a plus.

• You are enthusiastic about teamwork and can work well both independently and in a group.

• You are highly proficient in English.

• You have at least basic knowledge of MS Office (as a large part of the job involves recording, reporting, and online training).

• Wearing a sterile suit and strictly following procedures is no problem for you.

Our client is a well-established manufacturer of high-quality coffins, supplying products with a strong focus on craftsmanship, precision, and quality. To strengthen the production team in Drongen, we are looking for a motivated Machine Operator for the carpentry department.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator in the carpentry department, you will be responsible for various woodworking and production tasks, including:

• Operating planing, sawing, and gluing machines
• Processing and assembling wooden components
• Performing quality checks on finished products
• Ensuring production targets and quality standards are met
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment

We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience operating production or woodworking machines
• Has forklift experience or a valid forklift certificate (an advantage)
• Is not afraid of physical work
• Can communicate in Dutch, English, or French (Polish is also welcome)
• Is reliable, motivated, and quality-conscious

Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities

• Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.
• Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.
• Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.
• Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.
• Participate in technical training courses provided by various bus manufacturers.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

You communicate well in English, Dutch, or French.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

Experience working on trucks is an advantage; experience with buses is even better.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

Our client has over 100 years of expertise in cleaning and renting high-quality textiles. They provide their services to hospitals, healthcare institutions, and holiday parks in both the Netherlands and Belgium. Known for being accessible, nearby, and highly engaged, they are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining strong relationships with their clients. Joining their team means contributing to a legacy of excellence and reliability in the textile industry.

Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Driver with a passion for delivering excellent service? Our client is looking for dedicated Drivers to join their team in Oedelem (Oostkamp/Bruges). This is an exciting opportunity to work with a company that values reliability, professionalism, and teamwork.

Main Responsibilities:

• Operate vehicles (C and CE licenses) on fixed routes from Monday to Friday.
• Drive 50% of the time and assist with loading/unloading 50% of the time.
• Ensure timely and safe delivery of goods.
• Handle physically demanding tasks, including moving heavy carts.
• Maintain clear communication and adhere to schedules.

Profile Description

Our client is seeking Drivers who meet the following criteria:

• Valid C or CE driving license, medical clearance, and Code 95 certification.
• Excellent command of Dutch, French, or English.
• Physically fit and capable of handling heavy loads.
• Reliable, with a strong work ethic and minimal absenteeism.
• Able to provide good references.
